items.text: Do we say good afternoon to people between 5pm and 10pm?
Is your nationality British?
Is "the longest" the superlative of "long"?
Has each chair got four legs?
Do you leave your books in the classroom after the lesson?
Can you lift the table with your little finger?
Is autumn one of the four seasons of the year?
Are you younger than your mother?
Is it cool in spring?
Do I say goodbye to you at the beginning of the lesson?
Does the sun shine during the day?
Do you speak Portuguese worse than English?
Is it right to say "I am watching that picture"?
Can you hold your hand above your head for more than 5 hours?
Is it right to say "Every students are good at learning languages"?
Were we in this room 5 years ago?
Is the road between São José dos Campos and Ubatuba crooked?
Is the road between Novo Hamburgo and Gramado crooked?
Is the road between Jundiaí and São Paulo crooked?
Is the road between Franca and Ribeirão Preto crooked?
Is the road between Uberlândia and Uberaba crooked?
Is the road between Faro and Monchique crooked?
Is the road between Waterford and Dublin crooked?
Do we nod our heads when we say NO?
Are clouds made of water?
Is it rarely hot in Africa?
We call
every meal dinner.
We eat with a knife, fork and spoon.
I only put a little salt
and pepper on my food.
I've got less money
than the bank.
Most people rest on Sunday,
but some work.
The opposite of friendly is unfriendly.
There isn't enough air
in the church
because the windows are closed.
